Damage barriers are a mechanic in the of Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country. When a character has a damage barrier, they take does not reduce their . A damage barrier is summoned with a certain amount of HP (often a certain percentage of the affected character's maximum HP). The barrier can absorb this much damage before disappearing, with any remaining damage carrying over to the affected character. It is effectively similar to being healed for the equivalent amount of HP of the barrier, although more useful because it works even when the character is at high or maximum HP. A costumer survey postcard was a common practice in Japan around the 2000s that let fans give feedback to the developers and the publishers of the product. Xenosaga used this practice: * Customer survey postcard of Xenosaga Outer File - Xenosaga Outer File * Customer survey postcard of Xenosaga Freaks - Xenosaga Freaks * Customer survey postcard of Xenosaga I & II - Xenosaga I & II See also: * Survey of Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Aionios Moments - Xenoblade 3 Official Artworks Aionios Moments

When the CD 03 of Xenosaga Outer File was released, it was distributed alongside a costumer survey postcard that let fans give feedback to Monolith Soft and Namco Bandai. It was a common practice in Japan at that time, and mostly every Namco Bandai release included a costumer survey postcard, including Xenosaga Freaks and Xenosaga I & II. Since Outer File was never released outside Japan, this postcard never did either. Once the survey is completed, the fan must fix a 50-yen stamp, write some data (Name of store where the CD was purchased, adress, phone number, name, gender, year of birth, Occupation / Year of study and email adress), and lastly send the postcard to the following adress: 173

Dexterity is a in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country. It affects the of attacks in . It is generally a property of Drivers and enemies. The chance any hit has of landing is usually directly proportional to dexterity: in absence of other modifiers, it is equal to 75% * (the attacker's dexterity) / (the target's ). Other modifiers to hit chance tend to multiply directly on to this ratio, except for modifiers to "accuracy" or "evasion" which are added on after other multipliers. Party member dexterity can be increased by levelling up, equipping accessories that increase dexterity, using s that passively increase dexterity, or unlocking Driver Skills that increase dexterity.

Driver Skills are unlockable upgrades for Drivers in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country. They appear on a Driver's and can be unlocked using . Each one provides beneficial effects which increase the battle prowess of their Driver, with a variety of effects available such as increases or lengthening the duration of Driver Combo stages. Total EXP and character levels are both carried over into . In the , EXP is not earned during challenges. Elements are a property of most combatants and attacks in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country. There are a total of eight elements: Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Electric, Ice, Light, and Dark. While some attacks are of no element, the vast majority are one of these eight types. For players, the element of attacks is determined by the element of the weapon's , while for enemies, each individual attack is assigned a specific element.
